findings.current: That one word explained the bizarre sight unfolding before my eyes.
findings.defect: The source says “those two characters” (그 두 글자), referring to 재생. “One word” changes the stated quantity.
findings.rationale: The Korean explicitly describes 재생 as two characters; the assembled English instead calls it one word.
findings.replacement: Those two characters explained the bizarre sight unfolding before my eyes.

summary: The chapter is broadly faithful; one explicit quantity is changed.
